_help: Windows version of ico-preview: previews .ico files with a private build of netpbm's ico2png, which extracts the largest size in the icon as PNG — not a publicly-downloadable tool, so replace <ICO2PNG_PATH> with wherever your own equivalent lives. On Linux/macOS use ico-preview.linux-macos.json instead (netpng's ico2png, same CLI, publicly buildable). Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
